title: Home practical guide and safety card: floating leaf discs
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 77 (Home practical guide and safety card: floating leaf discs (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 77: Photosynthesis practicals: leaf discs and the starch test. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To show that leaves photosynthesise and make oxygen
equipment: A plastic syringe without a needle (10 ml or more)
A lamp or a sunny window, and a timer
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Dissolve half a teaspoon of bicarbonate of soda in a cup of water with one drop of washing-up liquid
Press the straw into a leaf to cut 10 discs, avoiding big veins
Put the discs in the syringe, draw in some solution, block the end with a finger and pull the plunger to remove air; the discs sink
Tip the discs into a cup of the solution
Put the cup in bright light and start the timer
Count how many discs float every minute for 15 minutes

questions.q: Big question: what pushes the discs up?
questions.a: Oxygen from photosynthesis in the air spaces.
